name: 78023 · Helotes, TX
findings: ZIP 78023 (Helotes) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78023 (Helotes) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78023 (Helotes) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
